text: Day one. Midnight. You're asleep. The auto-debit knocks on your account... and finds it empty. That same night, the bank's computer marks you overdue. Not a manager. A computer. You wake up to two S M S. One: E M I bounced. Two: a five hundred rupee fine for that failed debit, plus G S T. That's the bounce charge, at a big bank like H D F C. {playful} Your first fear: now they'll pile interest on top of this fine too. They can't. Since twenty twenty-four, R B I says: a flat penal charge. No interest on top of it. {deadpan} That helps a little. But your account... is still empty.
